rows.definition: The per-layer GLM-5.3-Flash (glm5_next) checkpoint tensor layers.N.hc_attn_base: the base term of the hyper-connection attention parameter set (hc_attn_fn/hc_attn_base/hc_attn_scale) consumed by the Sinkhorn-projected stream combiner; glm5next_forward requires it in the pinned manifest for every layer.
rows.distinction: The ATTENTION stream's base term, not the attention scale (hc_attn_scale) and not the FFN stream's base (hc_ffn_base) - the attn/ffn split mirrors attnSite's parameter-set selection.

rows.definition: The per-layer GLM-5.3-Flash (glm5_next) checkpoint tensor layers.N.hc_attn_scale: the scale term of the hyper-connection attention parameter set consumed by the Sinkhorn-projected stream combiner; required in the pinned manifest for every layer (glm5next_forward.go manifest check).
rows.distinction: The ATTENTION stream's scale term, not the attention base (hc_attn_base) and not the FFN stream's scale (hc_ffn_scale).

rows.definition: The second Megatron tensor-parallel building block in internal/model/tensor_parallel_attn.go: multi-head attention sharded by head across ranks - column-parallel Q/K/V over contiguous KV-head-group bands (GQA query heads map to their kv head's rank), row-parallel output projection with exactly one AllReduce per attention block, completing the within-a-layer TP pair proved by tensor_parallel.go's FFN block.
rows.distinction: The ATTENTION shard file, not the vocabulary-parallel plan (tpVocabPlan shards the vocab/LM-head axis) and not the FFN column/row block proved in tensor_parallel.go.

rows.definition: The GLM-5.3-Flash (glm5_next) indexer k-pool compression width (config json index_kpool, carried as d.indexKpool in glm5next_forward): the pooled-key width the DSA indexer scores over - pools of IndexKpool cached keys collapse into one scored candidate. Zero/absent keeps every other family untouched.
rows.distinction: A POOLING WIDTH config for the indexer's key candidates, not the incomplete-pool tail-append policy (IndexKpoolAlwaysSelectTail) and not the KV cache pool or agent k-pool reporters.

rows.definition: The GLM-5.3-Flash (glm5_next) bool config (json index_kpool_always_select_tail) that appends the current incomplete k-pool as raw token indices, so the DSA indexer always scores the tail pool instead of waiting until IndexKpool cached keys fill a complete pool.
rows.distinction: A TAIL-APPEND POLICY bool over the indexer's pools, not the pooled-key width itself (IndexKpool) and not a cache eviction or selection strategy elsewhere.

rows.definition: tpVocabPlan(cfg Config, ranks int) (TPPlan, error) in internal/model/tensor_parallel_vocab.go: builds the vocabulary-parallel plan over the model's vocab size - the tensor-parallel sharding applied to the LM-head/vocab axis rather than to a transformer block.
rows.distinction: The VOCAB-axis parallel plan, not the attention head shard (tensor_parallel_attn.go) and not the FFN column/row plan or a ctxplan cell plan.
